One lease owner per resource, active ownership cannot be replaced, epochs never decrease and survive release.
Effects need current owner, unexpired lease, matching resource/revision/fence, explicit policy authority and candidate admission.
Advice, message ACK, prompt and model output cannot change policy, lease, evidence admission or effect count.
Reserve and settle transitions preserve nonnegative liabilities and reserved plus settled at or below the cap.
Valid traces can admit a full evidence table, acquire a lease, reserve cost, perform an action and settle cost.

required_before_runtime_admission: Bind the candidate and concrete source digest to a refinement mapping.
Execute independent cross-process claims and persistence/restart/crash tests.
Demonstrate executor-side checks immediately before integration or runtime apply.
Authenticate evidence producers and trusted policy without model-controlled identity.
Run platform/security/storage/network checks for each of all 17 aspects.

limitations: The 17 aspects are distinct typed evidence slots; their hardware, runtime, network, UI, knowledge and operational behaviors are not proved by these models.

Single-owner safety assumes atomic, serialized transitions for one resource. Distributed lock implementation, durability, journal corruption recovery, host boot binding, renewal, ACL authentication and concurrent independent VM execution remain outside the proof.
The two Quint resource instances are checked separately; this is not a proof of multi-resource transactions or deadlock freedom.
Policy is trusted immutable input during a trace. Actual credential delegation, policy revocation delivery and privilege-granting workflows are not implemented or proved.

Revision and evidence key identifiers are opaque natural/integer abstractions. No digest collision resistance, signature verification, attestation freshness mechanism or key-producer independence is established.
Lean proves all finite transition traces from its stated invariant. Quint explores 400 seeded traces of at most 60 steps each; no exhaustive state-space, temporal fairness or liveness claim is made.
Lean and Quint are complementary reference encodings; a machine-checked equivalence or refinement between them has not been established.
No SMT solver was needed for this slice. No solver installation, dependency download, runtime deployment, production adapter call or model inference was performed.
Local /tmp logs are replay aids; the canonical receipt retains source/tool digests, exact argv, exit codes, bound/seed, witness counts and independent counterexample summaries.
